messages:
lina_s (Sales): Sierra wants a perf POC next Tue. They asked for variable bursts, sustained 400 QPS, microbursts to 2k for <30s, and SOC2 evidence before sign-off. Can eng + solutions scope runbook + cost estimate?

raj_e (Eng): Need inputs: avg QPS (400 given), prompt size (they said ~160 in / 120 out), region (us-west-2 preferred), and whether Dedicated with VPC peering is ok for the POC. Also confirm streaming vs non-streaming flows.

marta_solutions: On security call they requested TLS, customer-managed KMS (HSM-backed CMKs), VPC peering for control plane, and audit logs for all inference requests. They prefer Dedicated over on-prem.

lina_s (Sales): Confirmed: Dedicated with VPC peering acceptable. Targets: p95 <=250ms. Typical request ~=280 tokens total.

raj_e (Eng): Proposed test plan:
- Warmup 5m @50 QPS
- Ramp 10m to 500 QPS
- Sustained 30m @400-600 QPS
- Microbursts: 3x 30s @2k QPS spaced 10m apart
- Cooldown 5m @50 QPS
Metrics: p50/p95/p99, token/sec, cache hit rate, GPU util, queue length, 429/5xx rates, per-request tokens. Also run a 5m cold-cache test.

raj_e (Eng): Non-streaming load script example (vegeta):
```bash
echo '{"model":"rw-13b-v1","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":120}' > body.json
vegeta attack -rate=400 -duration=30m -targets=<(printf "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
@body.json") | vegeta report
```
Note: streaming paths require a custom runner to measure first-byte and last-byte timings.

marta_solutions: Security checklist for PO: customer CIDR, KMS ARN, SOC2 report, pentest window, and contract addendum for audit logs. I'll draft for legal.

kevin_oncall: Ops notes: enable autoscaling/burst capacity on the Dedicated pool. Fallback policy: shift 30% to rw-7b-quant if p95 >500ms >2m. Emergency thresholds in runbook.

kevin_oncall: Runbook snippet:
- If p95 > 500ms for >2m, throttle bursts and shift 30% traffic to rw-7b-quant.
- If errors >1% for 5m, abort and capture logs: /var/log/redwood/serving/*.log
- Alert p95>300ms (notify), errors>0.5% (page).

lina_s (Sales): Pricing question: Sierra wants a 2-week pilot estimate and a monthly estimate at 400 QPS sustained. Any ballpark?

raj_e (Eng): Quick calc: avg tokens/request ~280. At 400 QPS -> 112k tokens/sec -> ~9.6M tokens/min -> ~13.82B tokens/day? Wait re-check: 112k * 3600 = 403.2M tokens/hour -> *24 = 9.6768B tokens/day -> ~290.3B tokens/month. For two-week pilot (14d) ~135.5B tokens. That's large; recommend scaled smoke then extrapolate.

marta_solutions: For pricing present two scenarios: Hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit) with burst overage terms. Call out that Dedicated reduces unit cost for sustained load.

raj_e (Eng): Suggest test approach to save cost: preserve burst ratios but run at 10% amplitude for full shape, then one full-amplitude day to validate autoscaling and KV cache behavior. Extrapolate costs from those results.

lina_s (Sales): Sierra leans toward real numbers; I'll ask if they accept extrapolation from a scaled smoke run plus a one-day full run.

raj_e (Eng): Also include a test with KV cache disabled to show worst-case cold latencies. Include streaming test client for streaming flows. I'll attach pseudocode to the runbook.

marta_solutions: Action items:
- Raj: vegeta + streaming scripts + metric dashboard (p95/p99, token/sec, cache-hit) by EOD tomorrow.
- Kevin: emergency throttling + fallback policy, alert hooks to their PagerDuty.
- Lina: collect CIDR, KMS ARN, sample payload, and confirm Dedicated with peering.

deploy-bot: deploy status: Dedicated pool blueprint "sierra-dedicated-1" provisioning in us-west-2 (eta ~40m).

raj_e (Eng): Will run scaled smoke (10% amplitude) once pool ready and post initial numbers here. ETA for smoke results: before 3123457330.

lina_s (Sales): Thanks team. If smoke includes tail latencies + GPU util and a modeled cost table (hosted vs dedicated) we can present Thurs. :thumbsup:
